title: Blanket Dumplings
description: A fast, ingenious inversion of the classic dumpling: filling is scooped onto a pan, then draped with a wrapper and pinched shut — no folding required. Steamed in chicken broth and finished with chili crisp, soy, and sesame seeds, they come together in under 25 minutes.
equipment: large skillet or pan with lid

Blanket Dumplings 🥟

Comment “Recipe” and I’ll send you the full recipe for free.

These are by far the quickest and easiest way to make homemade dumplings, and you can have them on the table in under 25 minutes.

If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money.

Follow for more Weeknight Staples.

Ingredients

• 1 lb ground pork
• 1/3 cup green onions, thinly sliced
• 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated
• 4 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 tbsp oyster sauce
• 1 tsp black pepper
• 2 tbsp chili crisp
• 3 tbsp soy sauce
• 1½ tsp sesame oil
• 1 tbsp rice vinegar
• 18–20 dumpling wrappers
• 1/4 cup chicken broth
• Avocado oil

For Topping

• Soy sauce
• Chili crisp
• Green onions
• Sesame seeds

Instructions

1. In a bowl, combine the ground pork, green onions, grated ginger, garlic, oyster sauce, black pepper, chili crisp, soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. Mix until fully combined.
2. Use a cookie scoop to place mounds of the filling onto a sheet pan, leaving enough space between each one.
3. Place a dumpling wrapper over each mound and pinch the edges around the filling to seal.
4. Drizzle with avocado oil, pour in the chicken broth, cover, and steam for 10 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 160°F.
5. Top with soy sauce, chili crisp, green onions, and sesame seeds before serving with a side of rice.
